INSERT INTO price_history (listing_id, date, open, high, low, close, volume, source)
            VALUES (?1, ?2, ?3, ?4, ?5, ?6, ?7, 'YAHOO')
            ON CONFLICT (listing_id, date, source) DO UPDATE SET
              open   = excluded.open,
              high   = excluded.high,
              low    = excluded.low,
              close  = excluded.close,
              volume = excluded.volume
